summary: Large installations run steadily and updates always get through.

new.title: Risk Score parts as columns
new.text: The parts of the Risk Score are now columns in the Detailed and Summary findings, shown by default. You can sort and filter by them.

new.title: Easier filtering and selection in findings
new.text: The findings grids use the same filter panel as the CI list. Shift+click selects a range of rows; Ctrl+click adds one more.

new.title: See what a running step does
new.text: Operations > Jobs shows job runs started outside the pipeline, and what a running step is doing now, with progress where the step counts it.

new.title: Install in one line
new.text: The install takes the common answers as options, so the quickest install is one line. The install page and the README show five samples.

fixes.title: Updates always get through
fixes.text: While an update waits, no new run starts, so it installs when the current run ends. After six hours it ends a run from an older version, installs, and the next run starts on the new one.

fixes.title: Large installs finish their data sync
fixes.text: The data sync now works in bounded parts, and a sync that stops part-way is finished by the next. Brief database failures are retried for up to nine minutes.

fixes.title: Runs no longer hang on an ended step
fixes.text: A step whose job ended on its own is now closed, so the run goes on. Cancelling a run now works while it is active.

fixes.title: Run reports reach Invardia again
fixes.text: Collection run reports reach Invardia again, and each lists the steps that succeeded, so a solved problem closes by itself. Very slow steps are named.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Asset pages no longer warn of old data during a refresh, a sharp drop in assets from one source no longer sends a mail, and ServiceNow import problems show on the Guards page again.
